5313817021829.variantName: 3-Piece Christmas Window Cling Decals Set Reusable DIY Xmas Static Stickers Christmas Tree Snowflake Decals Glass Mirror Decor
5313817021829.sourceDescription:
Product Introduction
Elevate your Christmas styling with our minimalist luxury Christmas tree static window clings. The elegant palette of deep green, cream white and shimmer gold creates a sophisticated festive look, decorated with delicate snowflakes. Made of high-quality
 PVC static film with double-sided printing, the pattern maintains consistent aesthetics viewed from either side of the glass. Glue-free static design enables easy repositioning and residue-free removal. Waterproof and reusable, it is a refined decorative
 piece to build low-key festive beauty, and also a thoughtful holiday gift option.
Product Specifications

 Material: Premium PVC static film
 Single sheet size: 20cm × 30cm / 7.87 × 11.81 inch
 Pack: 3 sheets per set(3set)
 Gross weight: 70g
 Style: Minimalist green-gold Christmas tree & snowflake
 Printing: Double-sided clear printing

Application Scenarios
Suitable for villa French windows, dining room glass, vanity mirrors, show room glass partition, high-end shop window. Great for minimalist Christmas home styling, holiday scene decoration, interior photography props, exquisite Christmas gift for decor
 lovers.
Notes

 Compatible only with smooth clean glass and mirror surfaces.
 Wipe the surface completely before application; slight mist of water optimizes static adhesion.
 Always store flat on the original backing sheet to avoid permanent creases.
 Prevent long-term exposure under intense ultraviolet light to preserve the gold glitter print effect.
 Do not fold the clings forcibly.
Glue-Free Static Cling: This 3-piece Christmas window cling decals set uses static cling instead of adhesive, tape, or glue. Apply each decal to clean, smooth glass for seasonal decor that lifts away without sticky adhesive backing when removed as directed
Double-Sided Print: These Christmas window clings feature festive Christmas tree and snowflake designs that can be viewed from indoors and outdoors. Add a bright holiday touch to home windows, glass doors, mirrors, or storefront displays with one set of xmas window decorations
Nine stickers, three per set: Includes three PVC electrostatic stickers, each measuring 7.87 x 11.81 inches. This set features a classic green and gold color scheme. This three-piece set of Christmas tree and snowflake electrostatic stickers makes it easy to create harmonious holiday decorations.
Reusable & Waterproof: Made from PVC static cling film, these reusable window decals can be carefully removed, repositioned, rinsed if needed, and stored flat for another season. The waterproof design suits seasonal window decorating without glue or tape
Easy to Apply: Clean and fully dry the glass, peel off the protective backing, position the decal, and smooth out air bubbles. These xmas window static stickers work on smooth, non-porous glass such as windows, glass doors, mirrors, and shop showcases

5058194836429.sourceDescription:
Christmas Baubles
Add colour and detail to your Christmas tree with these decorative baubles. Their hanging format lets you spread the ornaments through the branches or combine them with other suitable festive displays for a coordinated seasonal arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Colour: Blue. Quantity: 18 pack.
Festive blue baubles with decorative detail design to enhance your Christmas tree display.
Includes 18 plastic ornaments for a coordinated and colourful seasonal arrangement.
Hanging format allows easy placement throughout branches or combined with other displays.
Designed specifically for indoor home use to create a focal point during the holidays.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: 18 Christmas baubles
Hanger included

5096042286729.baseName: Christmas Ornaments - Tree Decorations - Mixed Shapes and Finishes - Pink Silver Plastic - For Seasonal Displays - 60 Ornaments
5096042286729.variantName: Christmas Ornaments - Tree Decorations - Mixed Shapes and Finishes - Pink Silver Plastic - For Seasonal Displays - 60 Ornaments
5096042286729.sourceDescription:
Sixty pink and silver plastic hanging ornaments include smooth, glittered and printed baubles alongside other shapes. The collection is supplied in a gift box and is intended for indoor Christmas decorating. The coordinated contents let you plan the main colours and shapes before placing the individual decorations, so the arrangement can follow the space available.

The mix of shapes creates variation while keeping the colour scheme coordinated. Round pieces can fill open gaps, while the other outlines bring a change of shape among the branches. Spread similar designs around the tree for a repeating pattern, or group a few together to make a smaller themed section within a larger Christmas display.

The glitter detail adds another surface finish to the ornaments. It can be placed alongside plain or textured decorations to vary the appearance of a single display. Leave a little separation around the decorated faces so the pattern is visible, and handle the finished surfaces gently when moving the pieces between the tree and their storage space.

The plastic construction provides the shape for the decorative finish. Each piece can be moved between branches as you arrange the tree, so you can judge the balance of the display before settling on a position. Keep the front and outline visible by allowing some space between neighbouring decorations, particularly where several branches meet.

Designed as hanging decorations, the pieces can be distributed across the branches or brought together in a smaller seasonal arrangement. Start with the areas that face into the room, then turn the individual ornaments until their shapes can be seen.

Use the ornaments indoors on a Christmas tree or within a seasonal room display. After removing them from their supports, keep the collection together in its box and separate the decorated faces from heavy items, ready for arranging the set again.
Includes sixty mixed pink and silver plastic ornaments with smooth, glittered and printed finishes for versatile tree decoration.
Comes in a convenient gift box, making it easy to store and keep the coordinated collection organised between festive seasons.
Features a variety of shapes including baubles and other outlines to create visual interest and fill gaps on your Christmas tree.
Designed specifically for indoor seasonal displays, allowing you to arrange the decorations safely within your home environment.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof
Included: Gift box

Insert the metal stake into the garden ground

IP65 Waterproof for Outdoor: Solar Christmas tree garden stake lights have excellent waterproof feature which does very well outdoors in the rain, cold, and wind. Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Battery Powered
Battery power gives flexibility over positioning without relying on a nearby mains socket during use. Fit the specified battery type and follow the supplied instructions.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Self Adhesive
The self adhesive backing provides a direct way to attach the item to a compatible surface. Prepare the surface and align the position before pressing it into place.

Suction Attachment
Suction attachment works with suitable smooth surfaces. Clean and dry the contact area before fitting, then check the attachment regularly during use.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Battery powered design provides flexible positioning without the need for a nearby mains socket.
Features a recognisable Father Christmas motif to add festive character to your holiday decor.
Includes both self-adhesive backing and suction attachment options for versatile surface mounting.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for Indoor use
Shatterproof

This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. Its red finish is easy to coordinate with the surrounding setting.

Red Berry Accents

Hanging Detail
The hanging detail provides a defined point for positioning or storage. Use a compatible support so the item can hang in its intended orientation.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

5056903233729.sourceDescription:
Bring a candy-inspired detail to your Christmas tree with this pack of 3 matching 15cm white snowflake ornaments. Each decoration measures 15 x 15 x 2cm and combines a branching snowflake outline with a white textured surface and coloured sprinkle-style details. The textured design adds interest among plain baubles and ribbons, giving your tree a sweet-shop theme while retaining a familiar winter shape. A hanging loop provides a way to display each snowflake on a suitable branch or incorporate it into a decorative wreath or garland. Position the ornament where the outline can be seen clearly, then pair it with your own candy-cane decorations, bows and other seasonal accessories. The white design is also suited to indoor window arrangements, winter wonderland party displays and festive home decorating. Repeat the matching pieces across your arrangement to link different sections of the display. This option includes 3 snowflake decorations. The candy-style finish is decorative and the ornaments are not edible. Pair with your chosen festive colour scheme.
Candy Snowflake Decorations: Includes 3 matching 15cm white candy-style snowflake ornaments. Each piece measures 15 x 15 x 2cm and has a branching snowflake outline with a white textured surface and coloured sprinkle-style details, bringing a sweet-shop theme to Christmas trees and festive home displays.
Textured Festive Finish: A white textured surface is dotted with small coloured sprinkle-style details, giving the snowflake a candy-inspired look. This pattern adds visual interest beside plain baubles, ribbons and greenery, making the ornament a useful accent for a themed Christmas tree or an indoor winter display.
Hanging Ornament Design: Use the hanging loop to position each 15cm snowflake on a suitable branch, wreath or garland. Leave room around the branching shape to show its outline and textured detail, then combine with your own Christmas decorations to build a coordinated arrangement.
Winter Wonderland Theme: Combine these white snowflake decorations with candy-cane ornaments, bows and other seasonal accents for a sweet-inspired tree. Their familiar winter shape also suits Christmas window displays, festive party backdrops and decorative wreath arrangements indoors.
Pack And Display Details: Contains 3 matching snowflakes for repeating the design, with a 15cm outline and 2cm depth. Combine with your own tree accessories, ribbon and foliage for a themed arrangement. These candy-inspired ornaments are decorative and are not edible sweets.

Bring a cheerful seasonal touch to your home with this Christmas tree hanging decoration set featuring Santa, a snowman and a reindeer. Designed for festive display, this set offers an easy way to add character to your tree, mantel, shelves or other indoor decorating areas during the holiday season. The multicolour finish creates a playful look that suits a variety of Christmas themes, from traditional to whimsical. Made from ceramic, these decorations offer a decorative feel that works well for repeated seasonal use when handled with care. The set of 3 is a practical choice for building a coordinated display without needing to source matching pieces separately. Each decoration can be used on its own or styled together for a balanced festive arrangement. These hanging decorations are suitable for home display and can also be used for sheltered outdoor occasions where decorative accents are needed. They are easy to fold, store and bring out again for future celebrations, making them a convenient option for seasonal decorating. Whether you are refreshing your own Christmas d cor or adding a fun finishing touch to a themed event, this set provides a simple and attractive way to celebrate the season. A decorative choice for homes, gatherings and festive styling, it combines classic Christmas characters with a compact set format for easy display.

Easy to store and reuse: simple to pack away after the season and bring out again for future celebrations.
Versatile seasonal d cor: suitable for home display and sheltered outdoor occasions, as well as festive events and holiday styling.

Christmas Wreath
This Christmas wreath adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details
Material: Plastic. Quantity: 1 set.
Festive snowflake detailing adds a distinctive winter accent to your seasonal display.
Versatile plastic construction allows for easy placement and flexible arrangement styling.
Designed as a single set to create an immediate focal point for Christmas decorations.
Durable plastic material ensures longevity while maintaining its decorative shape.
Comes with 1 x Christmas Wreath

Bring a snowy festive feel to your front door with this Snow Flocked Pre-Lit Christmas Wreath. Available in 45cm and 60cm sizes, it’s beautifully illuminated by LEDs to add a magical festive glow to front doors, walls, windows and other areas of your home.

COLOUR SWITCH LEDS & LIGHT EFFECTS: Switch from warm white to multi-coloured LEDs to set the perfect festive mood. From gentle fades and twinkles to colour-changing displays, choose from a variety of light effects, with a memory chip remembering your last setting.

METAL FRAME FOR EASY HANGING: A durable circular metal frame makes the wreath easy to hang on front doors, walls, windows, or above your mantelpiece. Coloured dark green, it blends discreetly with the flocked foliage to create a neater, more attractive display when hanging.

Christmas Garland
This Christmas garland adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The red finish and polyester construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Snowflake Detail
Snowflake detailing adds a winter themed accent to the design. The pattern can be used alongside simpler decorations to vary the visual texture of a seasonal arrangement while keeping the display within a coordinated festive theme.

Double Sided Design
The two sided design gives you a choice of usable surfaces or presentation. Turn the item to the side that suits the intended arrangement.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Christmas Decoration
This Christmas decoration adds a festive detail to your Christmas display. The white finish and plastic and metal construction give it a defined appearance for Christmas at home.

Timer Function
A timer provides a way to organise the operating period. Set the available timing option to suit the activity and adjust it when your routine changes.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Coordinate colour and texture
Pair the stated colour and material with accents already present in the room. Repeating a colour across a few carefully chosen accessories can bring the arrangement together, while contrasting textures add interest without requiring a complete change of decor.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Suitable for side tables, hall stands, windowsills, mantels, shelves or cabinets, this compact Christmas decoration is ideal for adding atmosphere to living rooms, dining spaces and other indoor settings during the festive season.

Inflatable Santa
This inflatable santa adds a festive detail to your Christmas display.

Father Christmas Motif
A Father Christmas motif gives the design a recognisable festive character. It brings a seasonal focal point to the arrangement and can be paired with other Christmas decorations to create a consistent theme across the display.

Create a focal point
Use the decoration to draw attention to a chosen part of your arrangement. Giving it a little space around neighbouring pieces helps its outline and detail remain visible, whether it is displayed on its own or as part of a coordinated group.

Style around the occasion
A decorative accessory can help mark an occasion or refresh an established display. Arrange it with pieces of different heights or forms, keeping the overall grouping proportionate to the available space and the setting in which it will be viewed.

Give the detail room to show
Consider the background as well as the decoration itself. A simpler surrounding arrangement can make smaller details easier to appreciate, and a position away from visual clutter helps the chosen design remain the focus of the display.

A flexible finishing touch
Move the decoration within its intended setting when you want to change the look of an arrangement. Small adjustments to spacing and neighbouring colours can give familiar accessories a different presentation without adding more pieces.

Plan the display
Choose a suitable support or display position for the size and form of the product. Allow enough space around it for the room to remain practical, and use the stated indoor or outdoor suitability when deciding where it should be placed.

Care and presentation
Follow the care guidance for the stated material and handle decorative details gently. When the display changes, store the piece where its surface and shape will be supported, ready to bring out again for the next arrangement.

Product details

Festive Father Christmas motif adds a recognisable seasonal focal point to your holiday display.
Compact inflatable design measures 80 x 40 x 120 cm, ideal for creating a coordinated festive arrangement.
Versatile decoration suitable for indoor or outdoor placement to mark the Christmas occasion.
Easy to reposition and store, allowing flexible presentation changes throughout the season.
Guarantee - 1 month
Suitable for: Indoor & outdoor use

Hugely popular in America and increasingly loved in the UK, the Fraser Fir is chosen for its dense, bushy, silvery-green foliage and soft needles that are kind on hands when decorating. It gives off a sweet, citrusy scent that fills your home for as long as the tree is indoors, and its strong, upward-angled branches make decorating easy and hold heavier ornaments without trouble. When your tree arrives, cut a few centimetres from the base of the trunk and stand it in water straight away. Keep it in a stand with a water reservoir, topped up every 1-2 days, and away from radiators and fires so it stays fresh throughout Christmas.

PREMIUM QUALITY, FRESH FROM THE FARM - Our Christmas trees are grown in the UK, ensuring the highest growing standards, and cared for year round by our expert team
GREAT SHAPE & FRAGRANCE - The Fraser Fir owes much of its popularity to its strong base, thick branches and citrusy-sweet scent
STAND SOLD SEPARATELY - A stand with a water reservoir is vital for keeping your tree fresh. Pop your tree in, fill it with water and you're ready to decorate
